title: Inheritance Tax vs Estate Tax: What Most Families Don’t Know
bigPicture: Estate tax is taken from the dead person's money before family sees it. Inheritance tax is paid by the person who receives the gift. Most families pay neither.
whatYouNeedToKnow: The federal estate tax only hits estates over $13 million. Most families are far below that.
Only a few states charge inheritance tax. Most states charge nothing.
The estate pays estate tax. The heir pays inheritance tax. They are two different bills.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Missing filing deadlines because you did not know the tax existed.
actionSteps: Find out if your state has an estate or inheritance tax.
Gather death certificates and account statements in one safe place.
Ask a fee-only estate planner for a plain-English review.
